reason: The hypothesis proposes a novel intervention—engineering a lattice-matched inert interlayer on a support to induce epitaxial-like ordering at the nanoparticle–support interface—which is not suggested in any passage. It links this intervention to enhanced local chemical ordering (LCO) and increased diffusion activation energy, a mechanism that combines substrate-induced ordering with LCO-mediated diffusion barriers, an integration not found in the literature. The passages discuss LCO in bulk alloys (P8, P26), entropy-stabilized sluggish diffusion (P1, P9), and support effects (P2, P15), but none propose using an interlayer to template interfacial ordering for stability.
